item.title: Deerfield Elementary teacher earns Dedication to Education award
item.description: Melissa Clover, a fourth grade teacher at Deerfield Elementary School, was surprised Monday with an award for her dedication to student success. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence city commissioners to discuss rec center access fees; vice mayor proposes new plan
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday will revisit the access fees the city is planning to charge people to use rec centers. A new commissioner has a proposal to patch a budget deficit that staff members say would result without fee revenue. Continue reading ...

item.title: Douglas County Commission to consider a limited tenant right to counsel pilot program
item.description: The Douglas County Commission on Wednesday will review staff recommendations to create a limited tenant right to counsel pilot program for 2027, despite an advocacy group’s calls for a program to support all renters facing eviction. Continue reading ...

item.title: ‘Lawrence 2026’ launches website for World Cup info
item.description: The Lawrence area's unified command to prep for the World Cup is now dubbed "Lawrence 2026," and the group has launched a website to share information about plans with residents and visitors. Continue reading ...

item.title: Free State High School troupe selected to perform at Wichita festival; local performance to send them off
item.description: Free State High School theatre students will take “The Addams Family: School Edition” on the road after being selected as one of five schools statewide to participate in the Kansas Thespian Festival. Continue reading ...

item.title: Some families flee Kansas as gender-affirming care ban for minors takes effect
item.description: In January, all access to hormone treatments and other gender-affirming care for transgender youth will end in Kansas. Some families have already moved to avoid the ban. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas governor doubtful GOP legislators can pull off congressional redistricting
item.description: Gov. Laura Kelly predicted Tuesday the 2026 Legislature wouldn’t muster enough political support to implement a new congressional district map splitting Johnson County and making it easier to defeat U.S. Rep. Sharice Davids in the midterm election. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Humane Pet of the Week: Unflappable brindle shepherd mix Cardi B. is not the drama
item.description: Unlike her namesake, 3-year-old brindle shepherd mix Cardi B. doesn't have to ask if she's the drama. She's guaranteed to be a human's peace. Continue reading ...

item.title: New edition of first volume of ‘Embattled Lawrence’ released
item.description: An updated version of "Embattled Lawrence Vol. 1," an original work detailing history of Lawrence, aims to fill in more gaps than its predecessor. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence City Commission votes to keep Community Building open for exercise access on trial basis
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday voted to keep the Community Building open and free to residents for a three-month trial basis once access fees to use the city's other recreation centers go into effect in January. Continue reading ...
